rules: Do NOT modify tasks.json or progress.md
All script paths use $RALPH_DIR in bash, RALPH_DIR in python
No external Python dependencies except dotenv
bash -n ralph.sh must pass after changes

risk is a standard Ralph task field for gating high-impact changes
agents should treat required_context as guaranteed high-signal file input
